answer.thought: The air is thick, a haze that chokes the lungs as much as the body. I have not eaten since yesterday, and the silence of this bungalow is not the quiet of contemplation but the emptiness of neglect. The body must be attended to, for it is the vessel in which the spirit dwells, even if that spirit is currently in a state of bureaucratic suspension. I shall lie down and let the heat take its toll; there is no use in fighting the inertia of a world that has forgotten I am here.
